channel.title: Oil, gas & power · Market Pressure Map
channel.description: Daily news scored for its impact on Oil, gas & power in Indian markets. Today: headwind (−1.4).

item.title: [−2] Iran declares Hormuz closed after a tanker fire; Guard says three tankers hit mines on a southern route
item.description:
Iran disputes US claims that lanes were swept. Transits were 2 a day on 25 October against 85 before the war. Brent heads for an 11% monthly gain. Escalating.

Oil, gas & power: headwind (−2) — Supply disruption

Why it matters: A renewed closure keeps oil and LNG supply risk high for India, lifting import costs, freight and insurance, and pressuring the rupee and inflation.

Market gauges: Fiscal & trade balance −2, Inflation outlook −1, Rupee −1

Confidence: medium · horizon: weeks

item.title: [−1] Rupee edges up 2 paise to 95.26 per dollar after touching 95.38
item.description:
A slightly hawkish Fed and strong dollar weighed, but the stock rally and softer crude limited losses. Steadies after Wednesday's 21-paise fall. Ongoing pressure.

Oil, gas & power: mild headwind (−1) — Costly imports

Why it matters: A stable but weak rupee keeps imported oil and inputs costly while supporting exporters' earnings.

Market gauges: Rupee −1

Confidence: medium · horizon: days

item.title: [+1] India's LNG imports from Qatar surge nearly 370% in October as supplies recover
item.description:
Adds to expected record October LNG imports of 2.8 million tonnes. Recovery from earlier disruption, though at high prices and now threatened by Iran's renewed closure.

Oil, gas & power: mild tailwind (+1) — Gas supply recovers

Why it matters: More gas supports power, fertiliser and city gas, but high prices raise the import bill and any new Hormuz closure risks the flow.

Market gauges: Fiscal & trade balance −1

Confidence: medium · horizon: weeks
